entities.summary: Universidad Isabel I, also known as University Isabel I of Castile or University Isabel I, is a private, state-recognized university located in Burgos, Spain which offers studies in business, law, economics, humanities and health science degrees mainly for working professionals and trainees via blended learning and distance learning.
